title: Tracking
description: A hazy Times Square night smeared into vertical pixel-sorted streaks, with live blob tracking locked to every bright sign. It runs on its own 122 bpm pulse: columns kick and drag light down, boxes split into numbered children, scout boxes flicker on, curves arc between targets carrying little packets, and every 32 beats a scan line sweeps the frame as the IDs roll.
intent: The TouchDesigner blob-tracking edit, overclocked but still legible: a beat clock drives every layer (column kicks in the smear, pixel-drag tails pulled from the sharp photo, box splits, scout detections, relabelled lisp lines, track-to-track curves, a drop with a scan sweep), while real connected-component tracking stays steady underneath.
